Subject: Mobile demo pod ops & MDF clarity

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking the intro yesterday. AcmeCloud is excited to co-host a mobile demo pod at the Westfield Roadshow (June 18-19). We put together a short outline (attached) showing the pod footprint, 20–30 minute live demos, and a small geographical promo around the roadshow dates.

Before we lock staffing, my marketing ops lead Sarah asked for two things we need clarified from Redwood:
1) MDF: suggested total contribution and whether Redwood will cover booth hardware rental or if that should come out of MDF.
2) Cost split for printing, local travel stipends, and shared lead handling (if we do a paid registration add-on).

Can you confirm Redwood's typical MDF band for partner demo pods, and whether a 60/40 split (Acme/Redwood) is reasonable for this event? If the numbers look good we can spin up a simple MOU and move to signatures.

Attached: AcmeCloud-demo-outline.pptx

Best,
Oliver
Head of Alliances, AcmeCloud

Hi Oliver — great to sync yesterday, thanks for the outline. Looping in Marissa (Field Marketing) and Ben (Events ops) who will own budget and logistics respectively.

Initial answers and proposals from Redwood: 
- MDF: we can allocate up to $12,000 total for a mobile demo pod of this size. That typically covers co-paid local booth fees, printed collateral, and a small travel stipend for two SDRs. Redwood would cover booth hardware rental (monitors, table risers) as part of our operations budget, but printed materials and per-diem travel should be covered out of MDF.
- Split: Redwood is comfortable with a 60/40 split (AcmeCloud 60% / Redwood 40%) on MDF spend and shared promotional ad spend, with a 50/50 split on any incremental paid registration revenue after costs.
- Lead handling: we prefer joint lead routing into a shared workspace (HubSpot sequence) with a 24-48h SLA for first contact from either side. We can include lead ownership rules in the MOU.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Marissa to draft a two-page MDF_Term_Summary and a minimal MOU (cost lines + lead-handling + cancellation terms).
2) Ben to confirm staff travel allowances and add a staffing roster template.
3) Oliver / Sarah to confirm acceptance of MDF amount and split so we can send DocuSign.

Marissa & Ben — can you pick this up? Oliver — if that works I can route a DocuSign powerform for quick signature.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
